items.title: Baxter International (BAX) Received An FDA Warning Letter Over CGMP Violations
items.summary: Baxter International (NYSE:BAX) received an FDA warning letter citing multiple CGMP violations at a U.S. drug manufacturing site. The FDA cited cross contamination risks and weaknesses in aseptic processing controls that affect certain sterile pharmaceutical products. The letter outlines required corrective actions and also signals possible further FDA enforcement if Baxter does not remediate the issues.
